mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_orders( order_number, customer_id, status, inventory_status, total_amount, currency, payment_due_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderNumber}, #{customerId}, 'PENDING_PAYMENT', 'WAITING_RESERVATION', #{totalAmount}, #{currency}, #{paymentDueAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO order_events( order_id, actor_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, detail, trigger_source, scheduled_task_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{actorId}, #{type}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{detail}, #{triggerSource}, #{scheduledTaskId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
